company.shortDescription: Greptile is an AI code reviewer that automatically reviews pull requests with full codebase context.
company.description: Greptile is an AI code reviewer that automatically analyzes pull requests in platforms like GitHub and GitLab. It provides context-aware comments, suggestions, and summaries with full understanding of the codebase. The software learns from user interactions to customize suggestions based on team coding standards.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered pull request review platform that analyzes repositories with full codebase context to identify bugs, security issues, antipatterns, and coding-standard violations.
productsAndServices.name: Greptile AI Code Review

productsAndServices.description: An API for integrating Greptile’s code-analysis and review capabilities into custom software products, engineering workflows, and development tools.

productsAndServices.description: Enterprise deployment options for running Greptile in a customer-controlled AWS or air-gapped environment, with support for customer-selected large language model providers.
